items.headline: UK EMIR Phase II reconciliation deadline approaches
items.summary: UK EMIR Phase II reconciliation is set to begin September 28, 2026, adding numerous new fields including valuation updates that firms must match with counterparties and trade repositories.

items.headline: Molecule acquires physical gas specialist Trilogy
items.summary: CTRM vendor Molecule has acquired Trilogy Energy Solutions, adding deeper physical natural gas operations capability to its platform, per CTRM Center.

items.headline: Container port rankings shift amid Hormuz disruption
items.summary: Ningbo-Zhoushan overtook Singapore as the world's second-busiest container port in H1 2026, while Dubai's Jebel Ali fell sharply on Strait of Hormuz disruption, reshaping trade-lane routing decisions.

items.headline: Transpacific freight surge pressures trade finance terms
items.summary: Shanghai-Los Angeles container rates climbed to roughly $7,185 per FEU as carriers cut about 20% of capacity via blank sailings, tightening working-capital and LC timing assumptions for commodity shippers ahead of GRIs.
